material_identity: light oil immiscible with uncured NOA 61 (to be identified)

parameter_status.purpose: Liquid set chosen so the acoustics-off menisci approach the S08 Fig. 9b singlet faces: per-face density step and interfacial tension are apparatus choices (studies/S08-published-singlet).
parameter_status.resin_density_and_viscosity_and_liquid_i: Manufacturer typical values, not lot measurements
parameter_status.brine: Engineering reference values for about 4.5 % NaCl at room temperature; not measured
parameter_status.brine_resin_interfacial_tension: Explicit assumption, kept equal to the water/resin assumption (0.025 N/m)
parameter_status.oil: Density 850 kg/m3 is a target, typical of light mineral or silicone oils; sound speed, viscosity and index are placeholders. No specific oil has been identified that is immiscible with uncured NOA 61 and gives 5 mN/m; this is a requirement, not a claim
parameter_status.oil_resin_interfacial_tension: Required value (0.005 N/m), not a measured one; could need a surfactant

scope: Declared liquid assumptions for the S08 tuned-liquid Fig. 9b cell. Not measured properties.
